family.description: This entry represents phage portal proteins found in bacteriophage Mu (gp29 protein [swissprot:Q9T1W5]). This protein Forms the portal vertex of the capsid. This portal plays critical roles in head assembly, genome packaging, neck/tail attachment, and genome ejection. The portal protein multimerizes as a single ring-shaped homododecamer arranged around a central channel.
family.name: Portal protein of Mu bacteriophage
